items.headline: Top moments, highlights as Seahawks defeat Patriots in Super Bowl rematch
items.description: The 2026 NFL season opened with a rematch between last year's Super Bowl teams, the Seattle Seahawks and the New England Patriots. Here are all the highlights from the first game of the new season.

items.headline: Seahawks open season with win over Pats in Super Bowl rematch
items.description: Seahawks open season with win over Pats in Super Bowl rematch

items.headline: Seahawks take Week 1 win over Patriots, lose QB Darnold early
items.description: In a Super Bowl LX rematch, the Seahawks kicked off the NFL season with a win but lost QB Sam Darnold to a hip injury.

items.headline: Seahawks pick off Drake Maye 3 times to beat Patriots 13-10 in Super Bowl rematch
items.description: — Sam Darnold left the game injured, the offense was stagnant and sloppy mistakes put Seattle in a hole through three quarters.

items.headline: Seahawks QB Darnold (hip) exits after opening drive vs. Patriots
items.description: Seahawks quarterback Sam Darnold was ruled out of the season opener against the Patriots after suffering a hip injury on the opening drive.

items.headline: Seahawks down two safeties with Emmanwori (ankle) sidelined for opener
items.description: The Seahawks, already without Ty Okada for Wednesday's opener against the Patriots, also ruled out safety Nick Emmanwori, who is working his way back from ankle surgery.
